messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for inference-router v3.1.0 started (canary=5%). Monitoring: spike in 429s and CPU tail latency in eu-central :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Paging oncall -> @alex (primary) @maria (secondary). Severity P1. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC67890

alex: oncall acked, looking at request logs and k8s metrics now.

priya: seeing connection pool saturation to model-backend, a lot of `connection reset by peer` in sidecar logs. 95th latency climbing.

chen: grabbing canary pod logs -> connection_refused and retry storms from pooling change in new client lib.

tim: customer reports: "batch inference jobs failing with 429s", affected customers: ScaleAI, MediaFleet. Impact estimate: ~4% of total traffic, eu-central heavy.

alex: immediate mitigation plan: pause canary, flip feature flag for new pooling strategy, and start partial rollback if needed. Executing `kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference-router -n prod`

alex: disabling flag `router_new_pool_v3` via ff-admin: `ffctl disable router_new_pool_v3 --env=prod`

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Feature flag router_new_pool_v3 disabled. Traffic routed back to stable.

maria: metrics trending down after flag kill, 429s decreasing to baseline in 6m. Adding 30m monitoring window.

priya: note: some pods still show high open sockets, likely due to client lib not closing on error, collecting pstack and netstat dumps -> `/var/log/inference-router/canary-sockdump-4523456789.tgz`

chen: reproduced locally with new client: short bursts + keepalive disabled -> pool exhaustion. Root cause candidate: client version bump changed default keepalive and max_retries.

alex: deciding between quick rollback of image to v3.0.4 or patching client config. Leaning rollback to restore stability quickly. Initiating: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-router router=repo/inference-router:v3.0.4 -n prod`

deploy-bot: Rollback to v3.0.4 initiated. Healthchecks passing started.

sara: CS update: created ticket #3120, notified account teams for ScaleAI and MediaFleet, providing ETA for resolution and asking for logs.

tim: requesting temporary suppression of noisy canary alerts to avoid alert fatigue: `alertmanager silence` 45m for canary-429s rule.

maria: I'll hold the monitoring window, if stable at +20m we'll mark mitigated and close pager. Preparing summary for leadership.

priya: adding urgent work item: image CI should run a socket-stress test and client compatibility check for any library bumps.

alex: rollback completed, metrics look healthy, 429s back to baseline. Marking as mitigated.

oncall-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Create postmortem owner and timeline.

sara: volunteering for postmortem owner. Will draft PM-2026-041, include timeline, RCA (client lib default change), and action items: CI socket tests, require client lib bump approvals, add canary ramp lock at 0->5% for 10m.

chen: will open PR to pin client lib version and add a toggled keepalive setting.

alex: handoff: Maria, please monitor for the next 45m and prep a short blameless summary for execs.

maria: on it. Will post update in 30m and hand off to on-shift SRE after that.

sara: CS will follow up with affected customers and escalate refunds if needed.

oncall-bot: Last log: 4523457389 - no new 429/5xx alerts in 25m. Closing active pager, keeping on-watch channel open for 1hr.

alex: thanks team. Follow-ups: patch CI, pin libs, add canary socket e2e, and update runbook to include pooling kill-switch steps.

sara: filing postmortem doc now and will link once ready. Closing thread after watch period.
